@dev Pauses the contract, preventing certain state-changing operations.
 Only the owner (University) or an Admin can pause the contract.

@dev Unpauses the contract, allowing previously restricted state-changing operations.
 Only the owner (University) or an Admin can unpause the contract.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

addCourse(bytes32,string,uint256,string).details: Adds a new static course definition to the system. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can add courses.

params._credits: Number of credits for the course.
params._department: The department this course belongs to.

addCourseOffering(bytes32,string,string,.details: Adds a new offering for a course for a specific semester. This allows associating a specific doctor, exam date, and book with a course for a given term. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can add course offerings.

params._bookTitle: The title of the main book/resource.
params._doctorName: The name of the doctor teaching this offering.
params._examDate: The timestamp of the exam date (0 if not set yet).

constructor.details: Constructor for the CourseManagement contract. Executed once upon deployment.

params._identityContractAddress: The address of the Identity.sol contract for role verification.

deactivateCourse(bytes32).details: Deactivates a static course, preventing new offerings for it. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can deactivate courses.

params._courseId: Unique identifier of the course to deactivate.

getAllCourseOfferingsForCourse(bytes32).details: Retrieves all historical course offerings for a specific course. This function can be used by the University/Admin to view the full history.

params._courseId: The unique identifier of the course.

returns._0: An array of CourseOffering structs for all terms this course was offered.

getCourseOfferingDetails(bytes32,string).details: Retrieves the details of a specific course offering for a given semester. This function can be used by students to get the details of the course for their current enrolled term.

params._courseId: The unique identifier of the course.

getCourseStaticDetails(bytes32).details: Retrieves the static details of a course.

params._courseId: The unique identifier of the course.

returns.courseId: The unique identifier of the course.
returns.department: The department the course belongs to.
returns.isActive: True if the course is active.
returns.name: The name of the course.

getCoursesByDepartment(string).details: Retrieves a list of static course IDs belonging to a specific department.

getLatestCourseOfferingDetails(bytes32).details: Retrieves the details of the latest/current course offering for a specific course. This relies on the `currentActiveSemester` being set by the university.

params._courseId: The unique identifier of the course.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Pauses the contract, preventing certain state-changing operations. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can pause the contract.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setCurrentActiveSemester(string).details: Sets the current active semester for the university. This is used to retrieve the "latest" course offering for students. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can set the active semester.

params._semester: The string representing the current active semester (e.g., "Fall 2024").

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Unpauses the contract, allowing previously restricted state-changing operations. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can unpause the contract.

updateCourseOfferingDetails(bytes32,stri.details: Updates the details of an existing course offering for a specific semester. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can update course offerings.

params._newBookTitle: New title of the main book/resource.
params._semester: The semester of the offering to update.

updateCourseStaticDetails(bytes32,string.details: Updates the static details of an existing course. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can update course details.

params._courseId: Unique identifier of the course to update.
params._newDepartment: New department this course belongs to.
